items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-11-01
items.q: And I don't take lessons from Paul Sherry.

ctx.x: Yes, I heard that. I know that we struggled living down the road.

That's when we did a Calorie. I went past Ben's funeral and going back into the prison. We were friends all bringing the political society. I was with young men in the literary society. Back in the hall and out the funeral. And he struggled beyond the ultrasound on his porch. Louis Primer, not Leon, not the one running the 500, Louis Primer. He taken lessons from the ring there. And I don't take lessons from Paul Sherry.
She went back to where she... am I on the phone? Yeah. She has a PG-Y.
